fields.description: The opaque docname series. Nothing about the supervisor, the place or the period goes in the primary key.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: The progress report this form pays for. Required, because a payment form is the money half of a period somebody already described: the report says what happened and who was involved, and this form may pay only the volunteers it names, for days inside its period.
fields.label: Progress Report

fields.description: ACC-02. Where this payment belongs, and the anchor geo scoping filters this form by. A Link, never free text, and mandatory at creation. Held on this record rather than read through the report, because core's geo scoping filters each doctype on a field of its own; it is checked against the report's anchor on every save, so the two can never disagree.
fields.label: Geo Node

fields.description: The first day this form pays for. Copied from the paired report on every save and read-only here, so a form and its report cannot drift into covering different periods.
fields.label: Period From

fields.description: The last day this form pays for. Copied from the paired report on every save, like the first.
fields.label: Period To

fields.description: The currency every amount on this form is in. Filled from the society's configured currency in National Society Settings when the form is created, and never assumed in code: no currency appears as a literal anywhere in this module.
fields.label: Currency

fields.description: The grid: one row per volunteer per day, carrying that day's attendance and that day's stipend. Deliberately tall rather than wide. A row per day answers who attended on a given day with one filter, and the total payable for a volunteer with one sum, while a column per day would put the calendar in the schema and break the moment a period ran longer than the columns.
fields.label: Attendance

fields.description: The sum of every line's stipend, recomputed on every save. Derived and read-only: a total anybody could type is a total that will one day disagree with the rows it claims to add up. Per volunteer totals are not stored at all, for the same reason; they are computed from the same rows on request.
fields.label: Total Payable

fields.description: Where this form stands. Submitting it moves it to Pending Departmental Approval, which is a dead end on purpose: stipend approval runs from the supervisor to the head of the volunteer's department, departmental resolution is not built, and routing this through the geo engine instead would send it to a geo parent rather than to the head of department. Nobody can approve it, including an administrator, and the refusal says so. Owned by vmmsx/stipend/services/approval.py.
fields.label: Approval State

fields.description: When this form was submitted for approval. Cleared if it is withdrawn back to Draft, so the field always describes the submission that is currently outstanding.
fields.label: Submitted On

fields.description: Who submitted it. The supervisor half of the supervisor to head of department chain, recorded now so the eventual routing has both ends of it.
fields.label: Submitted By
